status: Current ICO and file-size wording drafted and checked against UI behavior. The term for transparency needs a second language pass; no integration or runtime validation.

entries.source: Saves one PNG-compressed icon image at the selected size (16–256 pixels). Your image keeps its proportions and is centred on a transparent square.
entries.wording: Ha po'lu un pinentan ikonu ni mana'dikiki' kumu PNG gi mineddung ni ma'atyik (16–256 pixels). I pinenta-mu ha adahi i hechura-ña ya machura gi talu' un kuadrådu ni tåya' kulot gi sanhalum-ña.
entries.why: ICO stores one compressed PNG at the chosen edge length. Retain the source proportions through the app's Adahi i hechura vocabulary, and express the transparent square as an uncoloured backing. Check idiomatic wording for the transparent backing before release.
entries.change: new wording for previously held entry

entries.source: Decoding this icon exceeds the available image memory budget.
entries.wording: Ti nahong i RAM ni ma sedi para u mafa'tinas i pinentan esti na ikonu ginin i sinahguan i dokumentu.
entries.why: Decode, not download or file size. Reuses the host locale's existing explanation of decoding an image into RAM.
entries.change: new wording for previously held entry

entries.source: The icon image dimensions do not match the dimensions recorded in the corresponding internal ICO directory entry.
entries.wording: Ti parehu i mineddung i pinentan ikonu yan i mineddung siha ni matugi' gi rehistrun esti na ikonu gi halum i dokumentu ICO.
entries.why: The relevant record is inside the ICO file and is the one for this icon. Do not use a term that leads readers to their filesystem directory.
entries.change: new wording for previously held entry

entries.source: Stores a lossless PNG as Base64 text, beginning with data:image/png;base64,. Open this text file again to recover the image. Base64 is larger than the PNG it contains.
entries.wording: Ha po'lu un PNG ni tåya' malaknos na infotmasion kumu tinige' Base64. Tutuhun i tinige' ni esti: «data:image/png;base64,». Baba ta'lu esti na dokumentu tinige' para un na'ta'lu i pinenta. I Base64 mås dångkulu ki i PNG ni gaigi gi halum-ña.
entries.why: The exact prefix, including its comma, is visually separated from sentence punctuation.

entries.source: The image exceeds the BMP file-size limit.
entries.wording: I dokumentun BMP ni para u mafa'tinas ginin esti na pinenta mås dångkulu ki i mineddung ni ma sedi para BMP.
entries.why: The output BMP would exceed its file-size limit, not the image dimensions.

entries.source: The image exceeds the DIB file-size limit.
entries.wording: I dokumentun DIB ni para u mafa'tinas ginin esti na pinenta mås dångkulu ki i mineddung ni ma sedi para DIB.
entries.why: Parallel wording for DIB so neighbouring error messages distinguish the file type, not the failure mechanism.

not_for_integration.source: This BMP or GIF uses a colour profile that AN Paint cannot convert yet. Convert it to sRGB PNG in a colour-managed editor before importing.
not_for_integration.wording: Esti na BMP pat GIF ha usa un profile i kulot ni ti siña ha kombi'ette i AN Paint på'gu. Kombi'ette para PNG sRGB gi un app ni ha apapacha i profile i kulot, åntis di un na'hålum.
not_for_integration.why: Merged #86 replaced the misleading BMP/GIF-only description with save20_unsupported_image_colour. ICO, DIB and platform colour import use the replacement; it already has direct Chamorro wording for converting to sRGB PNG in a colour-managed editor. The legacy key still contributes to the P2 source inventory until separately retired.
not_for_integration.change: new wording for previously held entry
not_for_integration.status: legacy resource, not used by the current importers; do not integrate or spend another language pass on this wording
